lessonsForPromotion.text: subscriptionTierGrantsStudio is duplicated THREE times across two repos (LDT api-server peEntitlement.ts:52, LDT smartsite-mcp entitlement.ts:27, hauska-map entitlementClient.ts:90) with no shared module and no divergence test. The test named 'matches api-server predicate' (smartsite-mcp/tests/entitlement.test.ts:101) asserts four hardcoded booleans against the LOCAL copy and never reads the api-server source, so one editor satisfies both sides. 'Gate at the tier and both surfaces inherit it' is structurally true only if the gate lives on the api-server ROUTE; it is false for any predicate-level gate.

The MCP inherits an api-server route gate correctly because peServiceUserId requires SERVICE_API_KEY plus X-PE-User-Id and resolvePeEntitlement then reads the tier from pe_user_entitlements for that user id. Tier is never taken from a header on this path. get_smart_site is the shipped precedent: no local gate, the paid requirement declared in its tool description, enforced upstream at research/brief.

pricing.ts is config for prices but NOT for the comparison-table structure. PricingModal.tsx:61-65 hand-writes GROUPS as a three-entry array naming answer/handoff/firm; nothing iterates Object.keys(PE_PRICING.groups). A fourth group added to config alone renders nothing and fails silently.

PE_PRICING.solo/studio/team .blurb and .features have zero consumers anywhere. Verified repo-wide by a regex grep on both the dotted and indexed forms, which exited 1. Only .badge, .title, .ctaLabel, the price labels, and the team seat fields actually render.

Do not expect the MCP test suite to catch a screens gate regression. tools.test.ts:23-29 sets defaultAuth to accessTier paid / subscriptionTier studio, so a Studio gate on the screen tools passes every existing assertion including the CORTEX_CALLS reach-cortex-once check. Adding the gate produces zero failures in that suite. A both-directions test must be written, following the pattern at tools.test.ts:501-545.

2026-08-31, LDT origin/main 26068a1e: the four screens routes (propertyExplorer.ts:546, :574, :596, :624) carry requirePeAuthenticated and nothing else, and the only two entitlement gate call sites in the entire Smart Site MCP tool surface are tools.ts:817 (run_report, deep) and tools.ts:851 (export_instrument, studio).

2026-08-31, hauska-map origin/main 8740558d: no screens client exists. git grep 'property-explorer/v1/screens' exits 1, and no screens path is on the deep-proxy allowlist in apps/property-explorer/api/_lib/deep-allowlist.ts, so any such call would 403. Screens are a connector-only capability today.

2026-08-31: 'Prospect' as a pricing tier appears in NO shipped surface in either repo. hauska-map git grep -ni prospect exits 1; the LDT hits are gtmInvestorFunnel 'qualified prospect' lead scoring, an unrelated concept. The comingSoon MatrixCellKind exists and renders but no pricing row uses it.

Site plan CAD is sold as Studio-only in the pricing table (pricing.ts groups.handoff) but is NOT studioGated in the PE workbench catalog (reports-catalog.ts SITEPLAN/SPPDF/SPDXF/SPIFC carry no studioGated flag), while the MCP DOES gate it via STUDIO_EXPORT_KINDS. Sold-versus-enforced divergence on one of the rows the P-101 regroup touches. Adjacent to P-101, not caused by it.

Studio two seats is a real entitlement change, not copy. seatsPurchasedForWire (peTeamRoster.ts:108-115) returns undefined for any tier other than team, which makes inviteTeamMember throw SEATS_PURCHASED_UNKNOWN 409; resolveTeamSeatsPurchased (peTeamSeatsFromStripe.ts:88) returns null for every non-team grant; and peTeamRoster.unit.test.ts:58 pins studio-with-3-seats to undefined. Four coordinated code changes plus Stripe configuration.
